**Fed-Poster** is a privacy-first, browser-native dashboard that lets you cross-post to **12+ social platforms** — Telegram, Bluesky, Mastodon, Discord, GitHub, Tumblr, DeviantArt, SafeW, and more — from a single, sleek interface. Your credentials never leave your device. This is the home for everything that lives **outside a pull request or a bug ticket**: ideas, questions, show-and-tell, platform requests, and roadmap chatter.

Whether you're a solo creator who just wants to share a blog link across five networks in one click, an agency juggling dozens of client accounts, or a developer curious about how a fully client-side app can talk to a dozen different APIs without a backend — you're in the right place. Pull up a chair.

---

## 🗂️ How Discussions Are Organized

To keep this space useful and searchable, please post in the **right category**. Moderators may move threads that land in the wrong bucket — this isn't punishment, it just helps future visitors find answers faster.

### 💡 Ideas & Feature Requests
The parking lot for "it would be cool if Fed-Poster could…" Start a thread here before opening a formal `feature_request` issue. Ideas that gain traction and a maintainer thumbs-up graduate into tracked issues on the roadmap. Include the *use case*, not just the feature — we care more about the problem you're solving than the specific button you want.

### 🙋 Q&A
Got a question that isn't a bug? API token won't save? Not sure which scope a GitHub token needs? Buffer proxy returning a 401? Ask here. Use the search bar first — chances are someone already hit the same wall. When you get a helpful answer, mark it as the answer so the next person finds it instantly.

### 📢 Announcements
Read-only (mostly). Releases, theme drops, pricing changes, platform deprecations, and the occasional community shout-out live here. Watch this category if you want to know the moment a new theme or platform ships.

### 🙌 Show & Tell
Built something on top of Fed-Poster? Automated a wild posting pipeline with cron + the dashboard? Skinned your own theme? Forked it for a niche use case? Post screenshots, links, and war stories here. This is the feel-good category — celebrate your wins and inspire others.

### 🗳️ Polls
Vote on what we build next. "Which platform should we add: Cohost, Nostr, or Pixelfed?" "Light theme by default or keep Deep Space?" Polls run for a set window and results feed directly into roadmap planning.

---

## ✅ Ground Rules

Fed-Poster is a small, volunteer-maintained project and this community is the lifeblood of it. We keep things warm and productive by following a short, sensible set of rules — the full legal version lives in our [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md), but the spirit is simple:

Be excellent to each other. Assume good intent. Disagree about features, not about people. No spam, no self-promotion unrelated to Fed-Poster, no sharing of credentials or private tokens (even your own — seriously, don't), and no platform bashing. If someone's asking a question you find obvious, either help kindly or scroll past — gatekeeping has no home here.

We welcome contributors of every background, skill level, language, and time zone. The maintainer team reads English as a primary language but we're patient with translation tools; take your time and write in whatever way you can express best.

---

## 🚀 Good First Posts

New here and not sure what to say? A few easy ways to break the ice:

Tell us what platforms you publish to and what drove you to try Fed-Poster in the first place — the "why" behind the tool is genuinely useful to us. Drop a screenshot of your favourite theme from the twelve built-in options (Deep Space, Cyberpunk, Synthwave, Emerald Forest, and friends) in Show & Tell. Ask a "does anyone know if…" question in Q&A — there are no dumb questions, only unanswered ones. Or vote in the latest Poll and shape what gets built next.

If you're a developer looking to contribute code, head over to [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full setup guide, then come back here and drop a note in Q&A tagged `contributing` so we can point you at a good first issue.

## 💖 Keeping Fed-Poster Alive

Fed-Poster is free and open source under the MIT licence. There's no venture funding, no ads in the dashboard, and no telemetry phoning home. The project survives on the time of its maintainers and the kindness of supporters. If Fed-Poster saves you an hour a week, consider [buying us a coffee on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/W3T61ZU5FS) — every contribution funds new platform integrations, theme design, and the occasional caffeine boost for a late-night bug fix.

More importantly: answer a question in Q&A, triage a duplicate issue, write a wiki page, or just say thanks. Community energy matters more than money.
